account.deleteReauth: For your security, sign out and sign in again, then delete your account within 10 minutes.
account.deleteRateLimited: Too many deletion attempts. Try again in an hour.
account.deleteSoleOwner: You are the only owner of: {workspaces}. Give the owner role to someone else or delete the workspace first.

members.title: Members
members.intro: People in this workspace and what their role lets them do.
members.removeDescription: They lose access to this workspace at once. Their conversations stay private and are deleted with the workspace's retention settings. Removing someone also ends their personal MCP tokens.
members.copyFailed: The link could not be copied: the browser refused. Allow clipboard access, then try again.
members.inviteHint: Send them the invitation link. They join after signing in with this address.
members.rolesHint: Viewers see dashboards and ask the assistant about synced data. Managers also read Jira live and propose changes they approve. Admins manage connections, members and settings. Owners also manage billing and can delete the workspace.
members.readOnlyNotice: Only owners and admins manage members.
members.noSsoHint: Without single sign-on, anyone holding an invitation link who signs in with the invited address can accept it: send links only to the invited person.

billing.title: Billing
billing.intro: Your plan and what it includes. Payments are handled by Stripe.
billing.teamPitch: The Team plan gives up to {seats} seats, {boards} synced boards and access from external AI clients.
billing.securityIncluded: Single sign-on, audit export, data retention, data export and deletion are included in every plan.
billing.checkoutDone: Thank you. Your plan updates as soon as Stripe confirms the payment.

errors.subscription_exists: This workspace already has a subscription. Use Manage billing to change it.
errors.no_checkout_url: Stripe did not open a payment page. Try again.
errors.stripe_error: Stripe could not be reached. Try again.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every change to connections, members, settings and Jira made through the assistant.
audit.forbidden: Only owners and admins see the audit log.
audit.exportHint: Download the log for a period (UTC days, both included; empty = everything). Each export is recorded in the log.

errors.export_in_progress: An export is already running. Wait for it to finish.
errors.export_rate_limited: Too many exports this hour. Try again later.

workspace.title: Workspace settings
workspace.intro: How long data is kept, and access from external AI clients.
workspace.readOnlyNotice: Only owners and admins change these settings.
workspace.retentionHint: A daily job deletes what is older than these periods.
workspace.conversationRetentionDaysHint: Between {min} and {max} days. Deleted with their messages and approvals.
workspace.usageRetentionDaysHint: Between {min} and {max} days. Token counts and costs on the Usage page.
workspace.auditRetentionDaysHint: Between {min} and {max} days. Entries younger than {min} days are never deleted.
workspace.externalMcpHint: Members can then create personal tokens that let Claude Desktop or other MCP clients read this workspace's metrics (read-only).

errors.forbidden_role: Only owners and admins change these settings.
errors.invalid_input: Check the numbers: each must be within its range.
errors.plan_required: External AI clients (MCP) are part of the Team plan.

workspace.deleteDescription: Deletes its connections, synced data, conversations, skills and settings for everyone, and stops its subscription. The audit log is kept 90 days as the record of the deletion. This cannot be undone.
workspace.deleteMismatch: Type the workspace name exactly to confirm.
workspace.externalMcpNotInPlan: Included in the Team plan. Upgrade on the Billing page to switch it on.

mcp.title: External AI clients (MCP)
mcp.intro: Let Claude Desktop or another MCP client read this workspace's metrics, as you, read-only. Endpoint: {endpoint}
mcp.createHint: A token acts as you in this workspace only, for the analytics tools (boards, metrics, forecasts, issue lists). It can never change Jira.
mcp.name: Name
mcp.createdHint: It is shown only once. Store it like a password.
mcp.desktopHint: Claude Desktop (claude_desktop_config.json), through the mcp-remote bridge:
mcp.insecureEndpoint: This server's address is not https, so no client configuration is offered: a token must never travel unencrypted. Ask your administrator to serve the app over https.
mcp.revokeDescription: Clients using it lose access at once.

errors.mcp_disabled: External AI clients are turned off for this workspace. An owner or admin can allow them in Workspace settings.
errors.plan_limit: External AI clients are not included in this workspace's plan.
errors.too_many_tokens: You already have 10 active tokens. Revoke one first.
